objective_for_doctor:
Age: 55
Sex: M
Chief Complaint: stridor

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: I have a known severe food allergy. I have been in contact with or ate something I’m allergic to, and since then I’ve had significant shortness of breath with a high-pitched sound when breathing in (stridor) and wheezing when I exhale. I also have pink skin lesions with severe itching (9/10), larger than 1 cm, and I’ve had swelling in my forehead and cheeks (right and left), along with nausea/vomiting and pain somewhere related to this—pain intensity 7/10, appearing quickly (8/10). I lost consciousness too.
